Lawyers, security teams and investigators need to know who stands behind an entity, what it is connected to and what its history is.

Many independent collectors (registers, the web, network infrastructure, social media, archives) feed one entity-resolution core; the link graph shows what no single source does.

It draws on these skills: [OSINT investigation](@/skills/osint-investigation.md), [Registry intelligence](@/skills/registry-intelligence.md), [Entity resolution](@/skills/entity-resolution.md), [Ownership and link analysis](@/skills/ownership-analysis.md), [Infrastructure OSINT](@/skills/infrastructure-osint.md), [Web and media forensics](@/skills/media-forensics.md), [Knowledge graph](@/skills/knowledge-graph.md), [Web automation and crawling](@/skills/web-automation.md) and [Continuous monitoring](@/skills/change-monitoring.md).

It is built with [Elixir](@/glossary/elixir.md), [Broadway](@/glossary/broadway.md), [Playwright](@/glossary/playwright.md), [PostgreSQL](@/glossary/postgresql.md), [Meilisearch](@/glossary/meilisearch.md) and [Cytoscape.js](@/glossary/cytoscape-js.md).

The technologies behind it, measured from the work that shows those skills: [JavaScript](@/glossary/javascript.md), [HTML](@/glossary/html.md), [Python](@/glossary/python.md), [Claude API](@/glossary/claude-api.md), [Shell](@/glossary/shell.md), [Alpine.js](@/glossary/alpine-js.md), [CSS](@/glossary/css.md) and [Dockerfile](@/glossary/dockerfile.md).

22 public repositories show its skills (22 by their own words).

It was delivered in client work under confidentiality agreements, in Real-estate developer and Financial and investment group, as Architect, Lead engineer, AI engineer, Data engineer, Investigator and Advisor; the use cases describe the principle and the intent, never a client, person, date or number.

How to read this page: the method and the use cases are written by me; the skills, technologies and public evidence are derived from measured data and link to their own pages, each a [repository](@/glossary/repository.md), a term or a skill.
